expectedIssues: Bottom nav labels are cut off below the screen edge and the gesture bar overlaps the icons
reportedIssues: The system home indicator (horizontal gesture bar) at the bottom of the screen overlaps the search icon in the bottom navigation bar, partially obscuring it and making the icon look broken.
Bottom navigation tabs use icons only (home, search, orders/bookmarks, profile) with no text labels, which can make their purpose ambiguous and hurts accessibility.
